Kakerou Crime Coverup System

A rumour is spread that there is a certain gamble where you can win hundreds of millions while risking 0¥,this naturally attracts down-on-their-luck (thus likely below average intelligence wise) and morally questionable (with debt or criminal history). And it is spread within higher societal sectors that they can easily frame others for their crimes. The higher ups provide millions to coverup the crime. After contact is made in a specific way,they are asked to meet in a certain location. At that location,after some time, a lady claims that the person groped her and calls for the police after scratching the mark’s arm,collecting skin samples. The police comes and performs the “bad cop” routine and threatens major punishment while pulling the mark’s hair to attract hair follicles. At that moment,a well dressed man arrives (creating an image of professional attitude and wealth) . This man makes the police leave the mark establishing a positive rapport. The man offers bandage (which have GPS trackers in them) in a luxurious car which the mark would accept establishing a great rapport . Essentially plays the good cop routine. Now ,this man takes them to Yuukide jr. . Yuukide jr. introduces himself as the son of a wealthy family who fell into a coma (due to sleepy sickness) and wants the person to bet memory of a day to fill the decade with the referring being done by a neutral organisation named Kakerou,for the sake of a “fair game”. The positive relation is transferred from the good cop to Yuukide Jr. preventing doubt. They play a game of paper labyrinth in which if Yuukide Jr. wins then they earn millions (as per date,date is the day a higher up committed crime) and if they loose then there’s no loss as it’s just memory of a date,”make believe”. Yuukide Jr. cheats by having a certain ink used such that an impression of the opponents labyrinth is left on the paper letting him cheat. Afterwards,they walk off “scotch free”. Only to be framed for a crime with physical evidence and without an alibi as Kakerou would suppress it as per the game. Now the referee being Kadokura isn’t  just a willy-nilly  choice,Kadokura was chosen for his orderly and systematic ideology which closely mirrors cog ideology and esteems Kakerou and it’s laws so would protect it over morality.or rather,Kakerou is his morality. Furthermore,Nanpou is present just in Cade and Nanpou was someone who had beaten Kadokura decades prior in a gang war.

1. It’s a 0¥ Gamble
2. It’s framing enacted by Yuukide
